title: Transcription engine
description: Which engine transcribes each kind of meeting. The on-demand speech engine is experimental: English only, with transcript quality below Amazon Transcribe.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings that start at least 30 seconds after the save; a meeting already running keeps its engine.

streamingEngineMicrovm.title: Stream Audio, Chrome extension and Desktop Capture
streamingEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker identification per channel is chosen per meeting, on the Stream Audio form or in the desktop app's settings.

virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.title: Virtual Participants
virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker names come from the meeting roster with either engine.

diarizeVirtualParticipant.title: Virtual Participant voice separation
diarizeVirtualParticipant.description: When one attendee is several people, such as a conference room, label their voices "Name (spk_0)", "Name (spk_1)". Requires the on-demand engine for Virtual Participants, and a model bundle with speaker identification.
